title: 小雷音寺识假佛
subtitle: 从小细节看见真相
origin: 《西游记》第六十五至六十六回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 耀眼的外表不一定代表真实；冷静观察、合作求证，再给犯错的人改正机会，才是有智慧的勇敢。
moral.en: A dazzling appearance is not always truthful. Wise courage means observing calmly, checking clues together, and giving someone a chance to make things right.

pages.zh: 师徒来到一座金光闪闪的小寺庙。唐僧正要进门，悟空却发现：屋檐铃铛在摇，地上的影子却一动不动。
pages.en: The travelers reached a glittering little temple. As Tang Seng approached, Wukong noticed that the roof bells swung while their shadows stayed still.

pages.zh: 殿里坐着一位自称佛祖的金眉主人，金袍大得拖在地上，帽子也歪歪的。悟空问了一个简单问题，他却只顾夸耀金光。
pages.en: Inside sat a golden-browed host claiming to be the Buddha, with an oversized robe pooling on the floor and a crooked cap. Wukong asked a simple question, but the host only boasted about the glitter.

pages.en: When the travelers were not fooled, Yellow Brow turned the two round clappers into a spacious, glowing golden bell-dome. “Solve the echo puzzle, and the door will open!”

pages.en: Bajie hummed softly, Sha Seng listened to the echoes, White Dragon Horse tapped a rhythm, and Wukong found the golden pattern that answered back.

pages.zh: 钟罩“叮”地打开了。唐僧没有生气，只问黄眉：“你把寺庙装得这么耀眼，是不是很想让大家注意你？”
pages.en: With a gentle chime, the dome opened. Tang Seng was not angry. “Did you make the temple so dazzling because you wanted everyone to notice you?” he asked Yellow Brow.

pages.en: Just then, Maitreya arrived with a cheerful smile. Recognizing Yellow Brow, he invited everyone to a nearby melon field for a cooperative listening game.

pages.en: Yellow Brow learned to tap the melons gently and listen, then returned the golden clappers to Maitreya. “I only wanted everyone to think I was impressive,” he admitted.
